styleLock.backgroundSystem: three recurring fields only: a matte deep green studio wall for the display hero, a pale sage/off-white flat field for infographic screens, and a graphite dark field for spec and macro screens; never photographic street clutter except the single pain-point panel

noDrift: no source brand marks, wordmarks, store badges or QR codes
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium tech-ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep pine green #0F5A4A, graphite black #17181A, pale sage #E4E6DC and off-white #F7F5F0 as base fields, with brass gold #C9A24C as the single accent and one restrained circuit blue #3D7FB8 allowed only on macro technology screens; neutral tone; backgrounds limited to a matte green studio wall, a pale flat infographic field and a graphite dark field; soft diffused key light from the upper left, low-contrast wrap shadows, always a real contact shadow, controlled specular rim on metal rims and matte housings, 5000-5600K; one modern geometric sans-serif family, thin-line pictograms on solid green discs with a brass highlight wedge, rounded speech-bubble cards with one pointed tail, hairline vertical rules and small kicker labels, wireframe sine-wave line mesh as the only decorative graphic; stable product scale and centring inside each band, product presentation angle kept consistent, label placement unchanged; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no brand marks or QR codes.

provenance.notes: 由一张详情页长图的 11 个切片提炼；形态判定为半入耳带长杆真无线耳机配开盖充电舱，与源夹（数码）一致，L1 手机数码 / L2 耳机音频逐字取自品类表。已剥离：源图品牌字样与店铺会员角标、二维码、参数表内的具体品牌行、全部数值（续航小时数、充电次数、蓝牙版本号、频响与阻抗、接口类型一律改为 {callout_*} 占位，生成时回填真值），以及源图重复填充的同一条占位文案。与库内前八版手机数码的区隔：真无线半入耳充电舱与森绿半入耳两版都是纯色棚拍或参数屏体系，本版的差异点落在视觉体系上——首屏为家居橱窗式绿墙加绸布圆台与吊灯绿植的展陈场景，正文为淡鼠尾草灰底上左右交替的圆角气泡机制卡、圆盘图标矩阵、线稿声波、冷电路蓝芯片微距与圆角参数卡，产品可视特征为墨绿机身加长杆与舱口抛光金属圈。若用户产品非该金属圈舱体，仍可沿用本版气泡卡与圆盘矩阵的信息图骨架。全 12 镜无实拍模特出镜，故未涉及人脸身份。
